ROUTER_FRAME_MAX.description: Largest request frame accepted from a link, and the largest response frame built (stream byte included). A link may report a smaller limit at runtime (BLE MTU).

VM_EXEC_MAX_SPAN_DEPTH.description: Maximum nested loop/span depth allowed during block execution.

VM_RETAIN_MAX_BYTES.description: Size of the stored record (2 + per object: 4 + name + value). A program retaining more is refused at load (ERR_VM_RETAIN_TOO_BIG). Costs twice this in RAM.

VM_BLOCK_MAX_IN.description: Maximum number of input accessors allowed for a single VM execution block.

VM_BLOCK_MAX_OUT.description: Maximum number of output objects allowed for a single VM execution block.

VM_BLOCK_MAX_EN.description: Maximum number of enable accessors allowed for a single VM execution block.

VM_STORE_MAX_POOL.description: Hard ceiling in bytes for the bump-allocated program storage arena.

VM_ACCESSOR_MAX_DEPTH.description: Maximum chain depth when resolving nested accessor paths.

VM_OBJ_COPY_MAX_DEPTH.description: Maximum tree recursion depth allowed when copying objects.

VM_DYN_MAX.description: Upper ceiling of live dynamically registered objects on the heap.

VM_SUB_MAX_SUBSCRIBERS.description: Maximum count of object IDs that can be subscribed to simultaneously. A subscribe packet with more IDs is refused.

VM_SUB_MAX_FRAME_LEN.description: Maximum byte size of a generated telemetry output packet.

VM_SUB_MAX_TRACKED.description: Objects telemetry keeps track of: every subscribed object plus everything reachable through its PTR children. Each costs 24 bytes of RAM (16 per entry, table sized 1.5x). Objects past the limit are not sent (ERR_VM_SUB_TRACK_FULL).
